definitions.explanation: A pre-printed outline drawing meant to be filled in with colored pencils, markers, or paints. Also refers to the activity itself. Long popular as a children's pastime; adult coloring books became widely popular in the 2010s.

CULTURAL NOTE:
A standard preschool and early-elementary activity. The adult-coloring boom in Japan, partly imported from Europe, brought intricate mandala-style and floral books to mainstream bookstores. {塗|ぬ}り{絵|え}⟦{療法|りょうほう}→療法：13615_ryouhou⟧ (coloring therapy) is sometimes used in mental-health and elderly-care settings.
